intro: North African cooking of warm spices and sweet-savoury contrasts: slow tagines, fluffy couscous and endless glasses of mint tea.
flavours: Cumin, cinnamon, saffron, preserved lemon, ras el hanout, dried fruit

dishes.name: Tagine
dishes.what: Stew named after the cone-lidded clay pot it comes in, like chicken with preserved lemon and olives.

dishes.name: Couscous
dishes.what: Steamed semolina grains under a stew of meat and seven vegetables, traditionally on Fridays.

dishes.name: Pastilla
dishes.what: Flaky pie of pigeon or chicken with almonds, dusted with sugar and cinnamon.

dishes.name: Harira
dishes.what: Tomato, lentil and chickpea soup, the traditional way to break the Ramadan fast.

dishes.name: Msemen
dishes.what: Square, flaky griddled flatbread eaten with honey or butter.

dishes.name: Mint tea
dishes.what: Green tea brewed with fresh mint and lots of sugar, poured from a height to froth it.
